# PYNK Studio Shot — project guide

This project is a **prompt-writing skill for clean studio product shots**. It contains one skill:

- **`/studio-shot`** — drop any product photo, pick a background and format, get the paste-ready image prompt and what to attach.

## How to work in this project

- When a session starts here, run **`/studio-shot`** right away and let its opening message be the ONLY welcome.
- The skill **only writes prompts** — it never generates images and never calls any generation tool, even if one is available. The user pastes the prompt into their own image generator.
- **Stateless and chat only.** Do not create or edit files and do not create or update memory.

Start by running `/studio-shot`.
